title: Figure 2. The Interior Region of Parallel Conducting Plates (Casimir effect)
description: Pencil-style drawing of two parallel conducting plates with large arrows pressing inward from either side, surrounded by long wavy lines representing vacuum field modes and short waves between the plates. Caption: "Figure 2. The Interior Region of Parallel Conducting Plates", explaining that the region experiences reduced quantum vacuum energy density, producing an attractive force. Text below discusses the Casimir effect and its experimental verification.
